metadata.source: Astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion / ICRS -> AltAz with ERFA; no production code or Astronomy Engine used
metadata.properMotion: pm_ra_cosdec and pm_dec, milliarcseconds per Julian year
metadata.distance: Unit-spherical input; no physical distance, radial velocity, or finite-distance parallax. ERFA pmsafe may override a missing distance internally; those warnings are retained. This is an angular-proper-motion reference, not full physical space motion.

iers.futurePolicy: 2050 outside table clips UT1-UTC to boundary; polar motion uses Astropy 50-year mean 0.035,0.29 arcsec; latest known leap seconds. Frozen model fixtures, not actual future UTC truth.

metadata.suggestedAcceptance: Spherical angular separation of ENU <=0.05 degrees; do not compare azimuth alone near zenith.
